relevance.rationale: Describes an algorithm for computing Coleman's p-adic polylogarithms to a given precision. This is the algorithm a live corpus probe implements, by name and by proposition number: computations/probes/gswz_coleman_li2_full_precision_probe.py opens by naming this article and this exact uploaded filename as 'THE previously-missing ingredient, now available' for bean qou-9p9y, and its body implements Prop 4.3 (the recursion g_0(v) = v - 1 - (v-1)^p/(v^p - (v-1)^p), g'_{n+1} = -g_n/(v - v^2), giving Li^{(p)}_n(z) = g_n(1/(1-z))), Prop 4.2 (the telescoped Frobenius formula recovering Li_n(zeta) from Li^{(p)}_n at Teichmueller points) and the coefficient-integrality/precision bound of Prop 6.1, then checks the result against printed data to mod 5^4. I verified all three propositions are present at those numbers in the PDF. Separately, an existing ledger row already treats a different article by one of the same authors as the source for the finite/p-adic polylogarithm bridge at rem:q-dilog-three-contexts; this one is the computational companion. references.ts has no entry for either. A production probe whose stated algorithm has no bibliographic entry is a citation gap on the critical path, not background.

keyResults.statement: Li^{(p)}_n(z) = g_n(1/(1-z)) where the g_n are determined by an explicit differential recursion with g_n(0) = 0.
keyResults.useForFolio: The series the corpus probe evaluates to 120 terms to obtain full-precision Coleman Li_2 at Teichmueller points; currently implemented against an uncited source.

keyResults.statement: For zeta a non-trivial (p^f - 1)-th root of unity, Li_n(zeta) is recovered from the Li^{(p)}_n(zeta^{p^r}) by a telescoped Frobenius sum with factor (p^{nf} - 1)^{-1}.
keyResults.useForFolio: The step that converts the computable truncated polylogarithm into the Coleman value at roots of unity, which is what the corpus's mod-5 dilogarithm cross-check needs.

keyResults.statement: The coefficients of the g_n are p-integral with an explicit valuation lower bound, giving a computable precision/truncation estimate.
keyResults.useForFolio: The proved premise behind the probe's truncation choice (N = 120, tail valuation > 20); without it the probe's precision claim is an assertion.

proposedActions.rationale: Core and orphan; a live probe names this article as its algorithm source and there is no ref() entry.

rem:q-dilog-three-contexts asserts a truncated F_p form and convergent Q_p / C_p forms of the q-dilogarithm with no citation; the computational p-adic polylogarithm side belongs there alongside the finite/p-adic bridge already proposed in the ledger for the companion article.
